healthAuthorities.name: FOD Volksgezondheid / SPF Santé publique
healthAuthorities.description: Federal Public Service Health, Food Chain Safety and Environment -- national digital-health strategy (e-Health Action Plan 2026-2029, Belgian Integrated Health Record).

healthAuthorities.name: eHealth-platform (Plateforme eHealth)
healthAuthorities.description: Federal public institution: Belgium's national health-data-exchange body, analogous to Finland's Kanta or Denmark's MedCom. Led by Frank Robben (general manager since 2008).

healthAuthorities.name: INAMI / RIZIV
healthAuthorities.description: National health-insurance institute; central to hospitals' federal operational financing (BMF/BFM). Led by Pedro Facon (administrateur général from 1 Jan 2026).

healthAuthorities.name: Departement Zorg (Flanders)
healthAuthorities.description: Merger (1 Jun 2023) of the former Vlaams Agentschap Zorg en Gezondheid and the WVG department; regional infrastructure-financing/recognition authority for Flemish hospitals. Led by Secretary-General Karine Moykens.

healthAuthorities.name: AVIQ (Agence pour une Vie de Qualité)
healthAuthorities.description: Walloon regional agency; infrastructure-financing/recognition authority for Walloon general hospitals.

healthAuthorities.name: Vivalis (COCOM/GGC, formerly Iriscare)
healthAuthorities.description: Bicommunal Brussels health/social-affairs administration. Hospital-network accreditation legally sits with COCOM's Collège réuni (Vivalis is the administrative contact point).

healthAuthorities.name: Ministry of the German-speaking Community (Health portfolio)
healthAuthorities.description: German-speaking Community government; Minister Lydia Klinkenberg holds the Family/Social Affairs/Housing/Health portfolio. Only confirmed formal hospital-governance role is as joint accreditor (with the Walloon Region) of Réseau Move.

hospitalGroups.name: Ziekenhuisnetwerk Gent
hospitalGroups.notes: Recognised loco-regional network; joined the voluntary Vlaams Ziekenhuisnetwerk (VZN) knowledge network as a group on 6 Jun 2025.

hospitalGroups.name: Ziekenhuisnetwerk Dender-Durme-Waas
hospitalGroups.notes: Base members AZ Nikolaas/AZ Lokeren (merged into Vitaz) and AZ Sint-Blasius Dendermonde.

hospitalGroups.name: Aalst hospital network (ASZ / OLV Aalst)
hospitalGroups.notes: Aalst-cluster portion of the original 2020-2022 recognition-annex grouping historically referred to as 'Ziekenhuisnetwerk Aalst-Brussel-Halle'; the Brussels-facing portion of that same annex grouping (UZ Brussel + AZ Sint-Maria Halle + AZorg) is treated here as the separately, more currently, sourced CUROZ network (see hg_curoz) -- the precise current relationship between the original annex grouping and these two operating clusters was not fully reconciled in research and is flagged as an open item.

hospitalGroups.name: E17-ziekenhuisnetwerk
hospitalGroups.notes: Jan Yperman Ziekenhuis (Ieper) joined as a full member 19 Jun 2025 (retroactive to 1 May 2025), after a separate proposed 'Westhoek' network with AZ West did not proceed.

hospitalGroups.name: Ziekenhuisnetwerk Midden-West-Vlaanderen (TRIaz)
hospitalGroups.notes: Base members AZ Delta, Jan Yperman, Sint-Andriesziekenhuis Tielt; current composition since Jan Yperman's 2025 move to E17 is unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: ZAS (Ziekenhuis aan de Stroom) -- ZNA + GZA Ziekenhuizen
hospitalGroups.notes: Combined Antwerp hospital group formed from the public ZNA (Ziekenhuis Netwerk Antwerpen) and private non-profit GZA Ziekenhuizen, collaborating on a shared EPD since 2016 with a planned full merger around 2024. 13 campuses per Zorgkwaliteit.be: 6 general hospitals, 6 specialised hospitals, 6 day centres, 2 polyclinics, 1 medical centre, 1 psychiatric facility, 1 dementia centre.

hospitalGroups.name: Helix network (Antwerp/Rupel area)
hospitalGroups.notes: Recognition status listed as 'uncertain' in the source material used to build the base membership list; not independently re-verified.

hospitalGroups.name: Plexus -- Zorgnetwerk Oost-Vlaams-Brabant
hospitalGroups.notes: Includes UZ Leuven, the originating institution of the Nexuzhealth platform.

hospitalGroups.name: Noordoost-Limburg network
hospitalGroups.notes: Recognition status listed as 'uncertain' in the source material used. Ziekenhuis Maas en Kempen (Maaseik) appears, per ZOL's current site, to have become an integrated ZOL campus -- not independently confirmed against an official merger announcement.

hospitalGroups.name: CHORUS
hospitalGroups.notes: Largest hospital network in Belgium: the public IRIS hospitals, the ULB university-hospital grouping (H.U.B.), and the private CHIREC group. Constituted 19 Nov 2021; CHIREC formally joined Dec 2021. A legal appeal for annulment against the network's constitution was reported in trade press; outcome unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: H.uni
hospitalGroups.notes: Christian/Catholic-affiliated, UCLouvain-linked network: Cliniques universitaires Saint-Luc, Cliniques de l'Europe, Clinique Saint-Jean, plus Clinique Saint-Pierre Ottignies (Walloon Brabant, out of scope for this Brussels-focused build). H.uni brand adopted 2021; four co-directors named ~2021, current (2026) status unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: CUROZ
hospitalGroups.notes: Flemish/VUB-affiliated network established Jan 2021: UZ Brussel, AZorg (East Flanders/Flemish Brabant, outside Brussels-Capital Region), AZ Sint-Maria Halle (Flemish Brabant). Each member hospital retains its own legal identity.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Phare
hospitalGroups.notes: Hainaut occidental / Wallonie picarde: CHWAPI, CHR Haute Senne, Centre Hospitalier de Mouscron, EpiCURA.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Helora
hospitalGroups.notes: Mons-Borinage / Centre du Hainaut: CHU Tivoli, Centres Hospitaliers Jolimont, CHU Ambroise Paré, CHR Mons-Hainaut. Trade press reported a 2022 'pause' (not divorce) in Tivoli's full merger into the group structure; current status unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Elipse
hospitalGroups.notes: Province of Liège, 8 institutions: CHU de Liège, CHR de la Citadelle, CHBA, CHR de Huy, Clinique André Renard, CHR de Verviers, Centre Hospitalier Reine Astrid Malmedy, ISoSL.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Move
hospitalGroups.notes: Joint Walloon Region / German-speaking Community network: CHC Groupe Santé (Liège) + St. Nikolaus-Hospital Eupen + Klinik St. Josef Sankt-Vith. A live joint EU procurement (TED 405372-2023) for a shared DPI was still unresolved as of the deadline; a 2025 network update confirms a supplier has since been selected internally (unnamed publicly), go-live targeted ~2028.

hospitalGroups.name: HUmani Santé Charleroi Chimay
hospitalGroups.notes: Public intercommunale created 21 Sep 2023 (merger of ISPPC/CHU de Charleroi and Centre de Santé des Fagnes); reported in Nov 2024 as facing insolvency risk in 2025, with a new president appointed 11 Mar 2025 under special oversight.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Hospitalier Charleroi Métropole
hospitalGroups.notes: Grand Hôpital de Charleroi (GHdC) and Clinique Notre-Dame de Grâce (CNDG), Gosselies. Approved by the Walloon Region Nov 2021.

hospitalGroups.name: Réseau Hospitalier Namurois (RHN)
hospitalGroups.notes: 6 institutions: CHR Sambre et Meuse (public intercommunale), CHU UCL Namur (private, UCLouvain-affiliated), Clinique Saint-Luc Bouge. Established 2020.

hospitalGroups.name: Vivalia
hospitalGroups.notes: Public intercommunale, sole general-hospital provider for the rural province of Luxembourg; pursuing a major site-consolidation programme ('Vivalia 2030').

procurementNotices.title: Levering en ondersteuning bij implementatie en onderhoud van een ziekenhuisbreed geïntegreerd EPD
procurementNotices.notes: Algemeen Ziekenhuis Sint-Maria vzw, Halle -- competitive procedure with negotiation, single bid received.

procurementNotices.title: Oproep tot aanvraag tot deelneming -- elektronisch patiëntendossier (call for participation)
procurementNotices.notes: AZ West, Veurne. 120-month contract duration; result not separately confirmed as an award notice, though the hospital is independently confirmed live on Nexuzhealth.

procurementNotices.title: Elektronische patiëntendossier: leveren, implementeren en onderhouden
procurementNotices.notes: Openbaar Psychiatrisch Zorgcentrum (OPZC) Rekem. Tender deadline 18 Aug 2022; 60-month contract + optional 5-year renewal. Award outcome unconfirmed.

procurementNotices.title: Aanschaf, implementatie en exploitatie van een elektronisch patiëntendossier (EPD)
procurementNotices.notes: Instituut voor Tropische Geneeskunde, Antwerpen -- new multidisciplinary EPD for outpatient clinic. 2 bids received (range EUR408,760-716,283.44); 8-year duration.

procurementNotices.title: Oproep tot aanvraag tot deelneming -- geïntegreerd patiëntendossier (EPD) across three hospital campuses
procurementNotices.notes: AZ Zeno, Knokke-Heist (ref. AZZENO/2023/010). Response deadline 3 May 2023. Independently confirmed elsewhere that AZ Zeno is live on Nexuzhealth, but no formal award/result notice for this specific tender was located.

procurementNotices.title: Appel à demandes de participation -- Fourniture, implémentation et maintenance d'un DPI intégré (incl. nursing information systems)
procurementNotices.notes: Joint tender: ASBL Groupe Santé CHC (Liège), Hôpital St. Nicolas (Eupen), Klinik St. Josef VoG (St. Vith). Deadline 22 Aug 2023; no award notice located. A 2025 network update confirms a supplier has since been selected internally, unnamed publicly, go-live targeted ~2028.
